# Kristian Cimò

> Kristian Cimò, freelance VFX, CGI and 3D artist in Milan. On-set supervision, compositing and CGI for Adidas, Coca-Cola, Generali and FC Barcelona.

Based in Milan, Italy, working remote worldwide.
Contact: kristiancimo@gmail.com
Instagram: https://instagram.com/kris.cimo

## Work

- [Bernal - Predator Elite Control Room](https://kristiancimo.it/work/bernal-control-room/): Adidas · September 2026 · CGI Supervisor · CGI Artist · Compositor. I supervised the shoot with Marc Bernal on set and handled the compositing on all nine shots: green screen keying, tracking, masking, relighting, rotoscoping, color matching and removals.

- [Raphinha - Never Miss](https://kristiancimo.it/work/raphinha-never-miss/): Adidas · September 2026 · CGI Supervisor · CGI Artist · Compositor. I supervised the shoot with Raphinha on set and handled the compositing: green screen keying, rotoscoping, tracking and relighting. Shot 04 was built in 3D in Blender, using photogrammetry.

I supervised the shoot with Dani Olmo and Pau Cubarsí on set and handled the compositing: green screen keying, rotoscoping, tracking and relighting. The environment in shot 06 was created in Blender.
- [Hawkers × Gasly](https://kristiancimo.it/work/hawkers-gasly/): Hawkers Co. · March 2026 · VFX · CGI · COMPOSITING. I rebuilt Dubai's Palm in CGI, extending the surrounding environment and creating a transition from the view of Gasly to the top view of Dubai.
- [Adidas - Legacy Museum](https://kristiancimo.it/work/adidas-legacy/): Adidas · December 2025 · VFX Supervision · 3D · Compositing. Adidas - Legacy Museum. Set extension and removal, tracking, keying and compositing across the campaign.
- [Zidane - Inspire Signature](https://kristiancimo.it/work/zidane-map/): Zinédine Zidane · May 2025 · CGI Artist. A topographic portrait of Zidane's career, rendered as 3D cartography. Every peak is a final, every valley a club he never returned to.
